// diagnostic

E2404

`` `?` can't turn a `{Source}` into a `{Target}` here ``.

What

`` `?` can't turn a `{Source}` into a `{Target}` here ``.

Why

`?` changes an error's type only when you've declared how via `impl Source -> Target { … }` (D-ERR-CONV); no such declaration exists for this pair.

Fix

add `impl {Source} -> {Target} { … }` before the function that uses `?`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2404: tests/ui/try_wrong_error.stderr.

Error [E2404]: `?` can't turn a `E1` into a `E2` here
  --> tests/ui/try_wrong_error.jet:11:10
    |
 11 |     x :: f()?
    |          ^^^^
 Why: `?` only changes an error's type when you've declared how; there's no declared way to turn `E1` into `E2`
 Fix: add `impl E1 => E2 { … }` before this function
